/dang po la gnyis/ rab byed kyi gzhung bshad pa dang*/ rab byed kyi mtshan bstan pa'/ོ /dang po la bzhi| thob bya ston pa sangs rgyas kyi che ba/ thob byed byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa/ spyod pa'i 'bras bu kun mkhyen gyi sgrub byed/ blo dman theg chen la skrag pa'i rgyu bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ dngos dang*/ phan yon dang*/ rtsod pa spang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sngar legs par bshad pa'i rin po che yi khyad par phyin ci ma log pa bzhi po 'di dag gang las rnyed ce na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams las sogs de yang ji lta bu zhe na/ thugs rje chen po 'gro ba ma lus pa'i don lhun gyis grub par mdzad pa zhig ste/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi sgo gsum gyi g.yo ba ni sems can la phan pa'i rgyu med pa 'ga' yang yod pa ma yin te/ sgo gsum gyi kun spyod ni 'bad med du sems can kho na'i don la 'jug cing*/ tha na dbugs tsam yang sems can rnams la gnas skabs dang mthar thug tu sman pa'i slad kho nar yang dag par 'byung ba'i phyir/ de yang sangs rgyas kyi dbugs ni/ dmyal ba pa'i gnod kyi steng du sprin gyi phung po chen po phyogs kyi mtha' ma lus pa khebs par gyur nas/ shin du bsil ba yi char gyi rgyun snyan pa'i 'brug sgra dang bcas pa phab ste/ dmyal ba yi me'i phung po zhi bar byas pas/ dmyal ba pa rnams gang gis mthus bdag cag 'di ltar sdug bsngal zhi bar 'gyur snyam du bsam pa na/ sangs rgyas kyi sku mtshan gyis spras pa mthong nas/ sems dang ba'i mthus thar pa cha mthun gyi dge ba bskyed nas gtan du ba'i phan 'dogs par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /'grel par ni/ theg chen grangs rnam dag mkhyen mnga' ba'i/ thugs la rang don sku gsung thugs 'jug pa/ /ming 'don med pa yang ma yin te| gzhan dag nyid kyi phyir ni 'jug par 'gyur ro zhes so/ /（16ba）gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su 'gro zhing bsnyain pa rnams ni/

'chi ba'i 'jigs pa sogs sdug bsngal thams cad las 'da' bar 'gyur te/ ji ltar 'jig rten kun la 'chi bdag ni/ sgras 'jigs pa bskyed par 'gyur ba de bzhin du/ kun mkhyen zhes pa'i sgra 'di ni thos pa'i sems can rnams 'chi bdag la yang 'jigs pa bskyed pa de/ 'chi bdag gi 'jigs pa las skyob par byed pa'i phyir te/ mdolas/ gang dag gis nga'i mtshan thos par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang*/ theg pa gsum las theg pa gang yang rung ba zhig gis yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du/ sangs rgyas zhes bya'i sgra 'di nyid/ /gang dag rnam par grags gyur pa// thams cad rnam par thar bya'i phyir/ /de nyid rgyu ru 'gyur ba'o/ /zhes so/ / gsum pa ni/ gal te/ sangs rgyas ni thams cad mkhyen par mi rigs te/ lung ma bstan bcu bzhi dris pa na brda mi sprod pa'i phyir ro/

/zhe na/ de tsam gyis thams cad mkhyen pa ma yin par sgrub par mi nus te/ thub pa la mdzad pa gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan pa sgrub pa dang*/ mdzad pa ma yin pa gnod par 'gyur ba dang*/ gsung bya yang dag pa dang*/ gsung bya ma yin pa phyin ci log rnams mngon sum du mkhyen pa mnga' ba'i phyir ro/ /kun mkhyen kun mkhyen ni ma yin no zhes bya ba la rgyu mtshan ci zhig yod med de/ dgos pa'i dbang gis lung ma bstan pa yang*/ gdul bya 'dul ba'i thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par yin pa des na ste de'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du/ dus dang bsam pa mkhyen khyod kyis/ /la lar dris kyang mi bya la/ /nyes skyon rnams kyang gsung mdzad cing*| |gzhan du kug nas bya bar mdzad/ /zhes so/ /gal te sangs rgyas ni gsung bya ma yin pa mi bya na/ lhas byin la gos dum can gyi bu mchil zan la ci zhes gsungs pa ma yin nam zhe na/ de ni nyes pa ma yin te/ gzhan la gnod pa'i ched du ma yin gyi/ gzhan la phan pa sgrub pa kho na'i ched du gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /phan sems kyi kun nas bslangs pa'i tshig ni mi snyan pa ltar snang yang*| dge ba kho nar 'gyur te/ sgo gsum gyi las kun la yid ni don so sor te gtso bor brjod par bya ba'i phyir/ rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir/ zhe na/ kun slong gi sems dge mi dge'i dbang gis ma gtogs par 'gro ba dang*/ 'ong ba sogs bsod nams bsod nams ma yin pa la sogs pa ma mthong ba de yi phyir ro// ji skad du/ gal te sems rab dang 'gyur na/ /las rnams shin tu dang 'gyur ba| |de'i phyir na ma bsal ba yis/ /sems dag pa'i las rnams bya zhes so/ / gnyis pa la drug sems bskyed kyi yon tan gzhan don ji ltar bya ba'i tshul/ / byang sems la sdang ba'i nyes dmigs/ dad par rigs pa/ zhar la （17na）sbyin pa'i sngags pa/ byang sems kyi yon tan bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis// sems kyi dbang gis dge legs su 'gyur tshul/

/sems skyed pa'i bsod nams bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhan don gyi bsam pa'i stobs kyi byang chub sems dpa' sems la dbang thob pa rnams la sbyin sogs dge ba'am/ gal te srog gcod sogs mi dge ba'am/ gzo dang spyod lam sogs lung du ma bstan pa'ang rung/ thams cad dge legs nyid du 'gyur te/ rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir na/ byang chub sems dpa' yid ni byang chub kyi sems de yi dbang du gyur pas mi dge ba la 'jug mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du/ gdug la snying rje chen po dang*/ /gdug min byams pa che skye ba/ /de phyir skyes bu mchog rnams la// sdig to'i sgo mo yod ma yin/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ rang nyid sems bskyed pa'i phan yon/ gzhan sems bskyed du bcug pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ gang nas bzung ste byang chub sems dpar 'gyur zhe na/ byang chub kyi sems ni/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems dang*/ don dam byang chub kyi sems gnyis las/ snga ma ni so so skye bo yi gnas skabs yod cing*/ phyi ma ni sa dang po nas bcu pa'i bar gyis bsdus so// sems bskyed pa de gnyis dang ldan pa la byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya'o/ /de yang don dam pa'i sems bskyed dang po'i bsod nams kyi khyad par bstan pas// gzhan rnams kyang khong du chud pa'i phyir/ re zhig sems bskyed pa dang po'i bsod nams kyi khyad par bstan ta ོ / /des na byang chub sems dpa'i don dam pa'i sems dang po bskyed pa'i bsod nams ni/ sa steng gi skye bo thams cad 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po nyid du gyur pa de dag gi bsod nams las ches khyad du 'phags te/ de ni chos nyid mngon du gyur pa'i sgo nas sems can kho na la phan par bzhugs pa'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du/ re zhig byang chub sems dpa' ni| gcig gi bsod nams gang yin pa/ /de 'dir gal te gzugs can na// 'gro yongs khyab nas gnas 'gyur te/

/sems can rnams mtha' yas phyir dang*| |sangs rgyas mkhyen pa tshad med dang/ /der ni yongs su bsngos pa'i phyir| |bsod nams de ni mtha' yas 'gyur zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gal te na gzhan sems bskyed du bcug pa'i bsod nams ji lta bu zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring srel gyi snying po can gyi mchod rten rgyu rin po che rang bzhin gyi mchod rten ni 'phang du 'og min gyi 'jig rten ji snyed tsam du mtho ba/ rgyar stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi tshad dang ldan pa zhig skyes bu 'gas byas te/ rgyan du mas brgyan cing mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs pas mchod pa de bas sems can gcig sems bskyed du bcug nas 'dul ba po yi bsod nams mchog tu bkrabs shing*/ khyad par du 'phags pa brjod pa yin te/ sangs rgyas kyi gdung rgyun mi （17ba）'chad cing*/ dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas pa'i bya ba byas pa'i phyir/ ji skad du/ gang phyir 'jig rten mthar thug par/ /dkon mchog gsum rgyun mi bcad phyir/ /rgyud kyi sa bon btab gyur pa/ /de phyir de yi bsod nams che/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ byang chub sems dpas ji ltar sems can gyi don bya zhe na| slob ma de la phan par 'dod pa'i bla ma yis dang por rang la dad par bya ba'i ched du/ slob ma la bsam pa dang mthun par lus ngag gi srid zhu bya dgos te| gdul bya'i bsam pa dang mthun pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don sgrub dgos pa'i phyir/ /gal te slob mas bla ma la sri zhu bya ba ma yin na/ bla mas slob ma la bsnyen bkur ji ltar bya zhe na/ de ni slob ma blo 'chal ba dang rang la phan pa'i don du/ bla ma la bsnyen bkur bya'o snyam du mi shes pa'i dbang du byas ste| rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir na/ slob ma des rang la phan pa'i bya ba dang bya ba ma yin pa mi shes pas/ rjes su bstan pa la ltos dgos pa de'i phyir na slob ma zhes bya bar 'jog pa'i phyir ro/

/ji skad du/ tshig snyan dag gis sri zhu yang*// bya ste yid rjes bzung na ni/ /de 'og bla mas slob ma la/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed nas de/ khad kyi khad kyis rgya che yi/ /chos rnams dang ni zab mo yid// chos kyis tshul la yang dag 'god/ /zhes so/ /gal te sri zhu byas kyang*/ slob ma gnod mi skur zhing*/ bla mar rgol ba sogs mi rigs par byed na yang skye bar mi bya zhing*/ slob ma'i nyon mongs gzhom pa la 'bad par rigs te/ nad pa khro yang*| 'byung pos gzung ba la sman pa 'khrug pa min pa de ltar thub pas gdul bya'i rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa dag la skyon du gzigs kyi/ nyon mongs pa dang bral ba'i gang zag gi 'brel ba'i gang zag la skyon du gzigs pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro| |ji skad du/ 'di 'dir sems can skyon min gyi/ /'di ni nyon mongs rnams skyon zhes/ /rnam par dpyad nas mkhas pa rnams/ /sems can dag la 'khrug min byed/ /ces so/ /des na gdul bya gang zhig sbyin sogs gang dang gang la dga' ba'i gdul bya de yi don de dang de sngar sangs rgyas shing bstan par bya ba yin te/ blo dang mi 'tsham pa'i chos bstan na/ mi mos pa dang yangs te rgyud nyams par gyur pa rnams dam pa'i chos kyi snod ni/ cis kyang mi snang ba'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du/ re zhig thog mar nyan pa po/ /sbyin gtam sogs la yang dag sbyar/ /snod du shes nas phyis de la/ /zab mo'i gtam ni bsnyad par bya| zhes so/ /cis te lan brgyar bzlog tu zin kyang*/ slob ma yang dang yang du mi rigs pa la 'jug na ji ltar bya zhe na/ de la byang chub sems dpas lhag par yang snying brtse bar bya dgos te/ ji ltar ma ni/ spyir bu la brtse zhing*/ khyad par du nad kyis thebs pa'i bu la shin tu yang gdung bar 'gyur ba （18na）dang de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa' yang*/ spyir sems can la brtse zhing*/ dam pa ma yin pa la khyad par du yang brtse ba skye ba'i phyir ro/

/ji skad du/ brtse ba'i bdag nyid can de rnams/ /sems can kun la sems snyam yod/ /de lta dang de rnams snying ni/ /sdig pa can dang khyad par du'o/ /zhes so/ /des na byang chub sems dpa' ni/ thabs dang rigs pa sna tshogs pa'i thabs rnams kyis de kho na nyid ma rtogs pa'i sems can rnams kyis de kho na nyid rtogs par byed do/ /de ni gdul bya nga rgyal can la la'i slob mar gyur par byas ste/ phan pa rjes su ston cing*/ rang nyid dman par sems pa la la yi ni bla mar gyur par bya ste/ khyad par bstan pa'i sgo nas gdams pa rjes su ston par byed pa'i phyir/ ji skad du| sems dpa' che rnams slob ma'am/ /sman pa'am yang dag tu 'gyur nas/ / de bzhin nyid dang de dag gis/ /sems can tshogs rnams 'dul par byed// ces so/ /des ji ltar sman pa mkhas par 'gyur bas/ nad pa gso dpyad kyis sgrub tu med cing*/ gsor mi rung ba'i dkon pa de bzhin du/ byang chub sems dpa' sems can 'dul ba'i stobs rnyed nas gdul bya ma yin pa ni/ shin tu dkon te/ de ni sems can gyi dbang po'i khyad par dang*/ bsdu ba pa'i dngos po la mkhas shing*/ thabs rigs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas sems can 'dul bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du/ sems can dbang po la yangs shing*/ /thabs mkhas yongs su shes phyir te/ /des na byang chub sems dpa' la/ /'dul min sems can shin tu dkon/ /zhes so/ /rang gi mthong ba'i yul du gyur pa'i sems can rnams dbang po dang mtshams pa'i chos bstan nas/ sdig pa'i las ma byed cig zhes bskul bar bya dgos te/ sems can 'dul ba'i mthu yi khyad par thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yul du na bskul na ngan 'gror mi 'gro zhing*/ gal te 'ga' zhig ma bskul bar sdig pa la spyad nas ngan song du 'gro bar 'gyur ba zhig na byang sems de la blo ldan byang sems gzhan gyi smad bya 'gyur ba'i phyir ro|

|ji skad du/ brtse chen rdzu 'phrul ldan yul du/ /chos dang lhan cig cha sbyar na| |'ga' zhig ngan 'gror 'gro 'gyur na/ /de ni mkhas pas smad par 'gyur| |zhes so/ /des na byang chub sems dpa' ni thog ma kho nar/ sems can rnams la snying brtse bar bya dgos te/ brtse ba snying brtse chen po med na/ byang chub sems dpa' gang gi sdug bsngal phyin pa nyen pa'i/ sems can gzhan dag la phan 'dogs pa'i snying brtse ba legs so zhes snyam du mi 'dod pa de ni/ rjes su brtse bas/ sems can mgon med pa dag la ji ltar sbyin pa gtong bar byed de| mi byed pa'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du/ gang la bu ltar sems can ni （18ba）kun la snying rje drag yod pa/ /de yi rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir/ /mgon med bdag la sbyin gtong nus/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa ni/ de lta bu byang chub sems dpa' la 'ga' zhig zhe sdang bar byed na nyes dmigs ji lta bu yod ce na/ byang chub sems dpa' la btang snyoms su gnas par dor ste/ shin tu gus pa'i sgo nas bsnyen bskur bya ba rigs te/ 'gro ba la phan pa'i phyir du zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig la/ 'jig rten gnas par ji srid du/ gzhan don du gnas pa'i mthu yod pa de la dad pa dang bsnyen bskur sogs ma byas par sor gnas pa dag kyang phung bar 'gyur na zhe sdang ba la sdig pa bab thag ci zhig yod de/ ngan song du 'gro bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ ji skad du/ 'di la mi gang lta zhig sems can thams cad la ni snying rab sdang gyur na/ rab tu sdang ba'i yid can de yi sdig pa gang zhig de ru bsdams pa/ de snyed sdig pa 'di na rgyal ba'i sras la khro ba bskyed pas 'thob 'gyur te/ de phyir rgyal sras khyu mchog me dang 'dra bar bltas te yang dag spang bar bya/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ des na byang chub sems dpa' la rab tu sdang ba spangs te/ mchog tu bya dka' ba mthong nas/ yid rab tu dad par bya bar rigs te/

bzod pa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gang la skye ba thams cad mi nyams pa'i mngon shes lnga char yod cing yang zhes pas spros pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ tshogs gnyis kyi 'bras bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod kyang*/ byang sems de yis gdul bya mchog nas dman pa'i bar du dman par lta ba'i ri bong dang*/ spre'u yang*/ ri dwags su ru ru la sogs pa'i lus kyi dngos po bzung nas| sems can gyi don byed pa 'di ni/ shin tu bya dka' ba rmad du byung ba'i mchog yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du/ gang las sems can yongs smin phyir/ / bsod nams phung po btang bya ste/ /brtse bas ngan song du skye ba/ /las 'di dam pa'i dka' spyod do/ /zhes so/ /yon tan gzhal du med pa mthong ba'i sgo nas kyang byang chub sems dpa' la dad pa bskyed par bya ste/ gzhan gyi don shin tu bya dka' ba yang sgrub nus pa'i thabs kyi bsod nams 'byung ba'i rgyu sgo gsum kun gyi tshe bstan pa'i bsod nams gang zhig dus shin tu yun ring po bskal ba grangs med par bsags pa'i bsod nams kyi tshad de ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i gzhal bya yang ma yin no zhes de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i phyir ro| |ji skad du/ gang zhig rgya mtsho'i chu thigs dang*/ /lhug po nyungs dkar sa gzhi ni/ /bag tsam dag gis 'jal nus te/ /byang chub sems dpa' yon tan 'jal| |zhes so/ /lnga pa ni/ gal te byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni yon tan rin chen du ma'i gter du gyur pa yin na （19na）ci'i phyir skyes pa'i rabs la sogs par sbyin pa'i sgra snyan par 'don gyi tshul khrims la sogs pa gzhan gyi ni ma yin nam ma yin no/ /zhe na/ byang sems rnams la sbyin pa'i sgra ni/ rtag tu snyan pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ sbyin pa'i sgra de yis skye ba dang rjes su mthun pa'i 'chi ba dang*/ gtong ba gsum gyi chos dang*/ ji ltar 'dod pa'i gnas su skye ba'i srid pa gzhan 'grub par gsal bar byed pa de'i phyir/

sbyin rkyen gyi dbang gis/ sbyin pa'i sgra skye ba dang rjes su mthun pa'i 'chi ba dang*/ mngon mtho'i bde ba sgrub pa dang*| chos gtong ba la yang 'jug go /de yang gtong ba ni gsum las/ zang zing gi sbyin pa ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa ni/ tshul 'khrims dang gzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /chos kyi sbyin pa ni/ bsam gtan dang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /brtson 'grus ni gsum cha la yang gtogs so/ /sbyin pa'i sgra de ltar 'jug pas sbyin pa'i sgra snyan pa yin no/ / 'di'i skabs kyi sgra sgrub ni gzhan du 'chad pa las shes par bya'o/ /ji skad du/ gang phyir sbyin pas gtong po dang*/ /len pa po la bde 'dren pa/ /de phyir sbyin sgra rdzogs pa yi/ /byang chub sems dpa' la rtag snyan/ /zhes so/ /ci ste byang chub sems dpa'i sbyin pa kho na mtha' yas kyi/ gzhan gyi sbyin pa ni ma yin no/ /zhe na| byang chub sems dpa' sbyin pa'i bsod nams ni 'bras bu chung nas kyang zad pa med pas/ sbyin pa gzhan las khyad par du 'phags te/ rang don gyi sbyin pa ni tshe 'dir sbyin pa'i sbyin pa la/ 'bras bu longs spyod chen po 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes bsam nas/ rdzas len pa dang*/ yongs su gtong ba ni khe yi ched du rdzas gtong ba'i tshong sogs bzhin du dam pas smad par 'gyur zhing*/ byang chub sems dpa' sbyin pa ni snying rje'i dbang gis gzhan la phan pa'i ched du gtong ba'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du/ sbyin dag ser sna dang bral ba/ /snod dam snod min de dag la/ /mnyam par sems snyoms pas gtong ba'i/ /sbyin de sbyin pa po la dag /brtse bas sbyin dang sbyin pa'i 'bras/

/gnyis ka'ang cig car don gnyer la/ /gtong ba'i sbyin gang ser sna med/ /de ni dam pa rnams kyi bsngags| |zhes so/ / drug pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems can gyi don mtha' dag sgrub nus te/ byang chub sems dpa' gang la sngar so so skye bo'i dus su byas pa'i sdig pa de'ang cung zad yod pa nyid kyang*/ 'bras bu 'byin nus su yod pa ma yin zhing*| dge ba'i las can gyi byang sems de la ni/ gzhan don sgrub pa ma yin no zhes bya ba yod pa ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du/ gang gi chos kyi sgrib pa rnams| |rnam pa kun tu spangs gyur pa/（19ba）/mya ngan 'das pa de dag la// bsgrub par bya min ci yang med/ /zhes so/ /gal te byang chub sems dpa' ni gcig tu dge zhing 'khor bar mi ldog pa yin na/ mya ngan las 'das par ci'i phyir mi 'gro zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' ni snying rje'i dbang gis zhi bde tsam la gnas par mi byed de/ byang chub sems dpa' de la srid par gnas pa dang*/ mya ngan las 'das par zhugs pa la gnod pa med par khyad par med phyir ro// rtags grub ste/ lhag pa'i bsam pa rlabs chen po yid can de la ni/ 'khor ba 'di na'ang gnod pa cung zad kyang yod pa ma yin te/ rgyu mtshan de na'o/ /ji skad du| |dbang bcu rnam dag dbang 'gyur ba/ /kun kyang gang dag la yod pa/ /de dag la der srid pa'am/ /mya ngan 'das khyad ci zhig yod/ /zhes so/ /cis sems bskyed pa dang po nas bzung stai/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams sems can gyi don la dbang 'byor par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba ni 'di la rgyu ci zhig yod ce na| byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa rnams ni rang gis ngang gis sems can gyi don 'grub par 'gyur te/ sa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gang la dus kun tu kun gyi tshe sems la dbang na/ thob pa nyid las gzhan don du bsam bzhin du srid par skye ba yin pa'i nus pa yod par gyur pa de ko rgyu mtshan cis na|

'jig rten na kun gyi ma'ang bdag 'gyur ba ma yin te 'gyur ba kho na yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du/ gang dag la ni yid dag dang*/ /bsod nams stobs yongs yod 'gyur ba/ /de dag bsam bzhin 'gro bar ni/ /mi 'gyur zhes 'dir rgyu ci yod/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa spyod pa'i 'bras bu kun gyi sgrub byed ni/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa de ltar spyad pa la 'bras bu ci zhig 'byung zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dpe med pa mthu yis khyad par bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba rnams 'byung ngo*/ /de la spyod pa pa la sogs pa kha cig re/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni thams cad mkhyen pa ma yin te/ skyes bu nyid yin pa'i phyir ro// dper na/ mi gzhan bzhin zhes zer ro/ /de ni mi rigs te/ gtan tshigs des bsgrub bya mi nus shing*/ /thams cad mkhyen pa khas len par rigs pa'i phyir ro| |ji ltar zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mthu yang nges par yod do zhes rtogs par gyis shig ste khas len par rigs te/ dper na/ phul du 'gro ba las ches phul du 'gro ba/ rigs kyi phul du byung ba bram ze dang*/ skye gnas kyi phul du byung ba srid rtse dang*/ rgyal po'i phul du byung ba 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po la sogs pa 'ga' zhig 'jig rten 'dir yang snang ba des ni te de'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du/（20na）mngon sum min don gang de dag /mngon sum don gyi rtogs bya de/ /med ces bya bar brjod min te/ /che kun che rnams la 'gyur ro/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa blo dman theg chen la skrag pa'i rgyu ni/ cis te sems can phal cher theg pa chen po la skrag cing sangs rgyas thob pa'i ched du ci'i phyir gus par mi byed ce na/ blo zhan pas zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos la skrag nas mi 'jug pa yin te/ blun po 'ga' zhig la shin tu zab pa'i chos stong pa nyid la skrag pa skye ba ji lta ba de bzhin rigs dang blo gros zhan pa la yang shin tu rmad du byung ba'i chos theg pa chen po dang*/

sangs rgyas kyi mthu phul du byung ba la skrag pa skye bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du/ zab pa dang ni rgya che'i gtam/ /phal cher theg pa che las bstan/ /des na yid chung dman pa rnams/ /'di la skrag pa yang dag skya ེ | |chos 'di blo chung rnams dang ni/ /dman pa rnams kyi'ang spyod yul min// chos 'di sangs rgyas sras rnams kyi/ /yul du rgyal ba rnams kyis gsungs/ /lha yi theg dang tshangs pa'i theg /nyi tshe ba yi theg pa gang*/ /thams cad theg pa chen po yi/ /gnas chen 'dir ni 'du bar 'gyur/ /de phyir 'di ni theg chen nam// gang phyir che rnams kyis bsten pa'am/ /yon tan chen po nyid kyi phyir/ /che rnams kyis 'di bzung ba'am/ /yon tan phung po chen por ni/ /mya ngan 'das rnams phan 'dogs pa'am/ /dam pa rnams kyis mchod pa'i phyir/ /'di ni theg pa chen por 'dod/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rnal 'byor spyod pa bzhi brgya pa las byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bstan pa ste rab tu byed pa lnga pa'o// // rab byed drug pa/ nyon mongs pa spang ba'i thabs bstan pa/ gnyis pa la 'gal rkyen nyon mongs spong ba'i thabs la gnyis/ rab byed kyi gzhung bshad/ rab byed kyi mtshan bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ gzhan gyi nyon mongs spong ba'i gnyen po dgag rang gi nyon mongs spong ba'i gnyen po bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gal te nyon mongs spang bar bya ba yin na/ nyon mongs skye ba'i gzhi spang dgos la nyon mongs kyi gzhi gzugs sogs ni bde ba dang rjes su mthun pa yin pas/ bde ba 'phel zhing bde ba las kyang 'dod chags 'phel ba'i phyir ro/ /des na 'dod chags spong ba la yul yang spong dgos te/ rlung dang nyi ma yi tsha grang gis bcom zhing*/ skra 'bal ba la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal mngon nus pas/ dka' thub can zhes bya'o zhe na/ rgyu mtshan cis na bde ba dang ldan pa dka' thub can ma yin zhing*/ zas gcod pa sogs sdug pa ldan pa dka' thub can cis yin te mi rigs par gyur te/

yul longs spyod pa bde bas 'dod chags 'phel bar 'gyur zhing*/ lus sems sdug pas khro ba 'phel bar 'gyur bas gnyis（20ba）ka yang spang bya yin pa'i phyir| ji skad du/ mi gang mkhas bde 'dod chags kyi/ /me yi gdung ba bzod pa de/ /don dam par na dka' thub can/ /sdug la 'dod chags me yod min/ / gal te phyi gdung nang rmongs phyir/ /dka' thub can de nyid du min/ /ri dwags 'dab chags thams cad kyang*/ /ci'i phyir dka' thub can mi 'gyur/ /chos mi mthun phyir rigs pa yis/ /gnyis kyis dka' thub can mi 'gyur/ /'di ni tsha grang dag cig car/ /gnas yod ma yin ji bzhin no/ /gal te 'dod pa tshad ma ni| |chos dang chos ni ma yin pa'i/ /gdung la 'dod pa mtshungs par 'gyur// gal te dam pa'i blo chos na/ /dam min blo yi chos mi 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ nyon mongs so so'i gnyen po dang*/ spyi'i gnyen po bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum/ nyon mongs so so yi byed las/ nyon mongs skye ba'i go rim/ ji ltar spong ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po la gnyis/ dngos kyi don dang*/ nyon mongs can gyi rtags ston pa'i tshul lo/ /dang po ni/ 'dod chags la sogs pa nyon mongs pa'i byed las shes par byas nas gnyen po bsten par rigs te/ 'dod chags kyi byed las ni/ sems pa'i yul sdud pa ste/ gnyen por mi sdug pa sgom pa dang*/ khong khro'i byed las ni/ 'thab cing rtsod pa ste/ de'i gnyen por byams pa sgom pa dang*/ me sogs 'byung ba kun la rlung gis stobs bskyed pa bzhin du/ gti mug gi byed las ni chags sdang gnyis ka'i gsos 'debs par byed pas gnyen po rten 'brel gyi gnas lugs sgom dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du/ chags pas bud med dag la sbrel/ /zhe sdang gis ni byams pa 'joms/ /de la rmongs phyir blun pa yis/ /yang dag nyes pa mi mthong ngo*| |zhes so/ /cis te dug gsum gyi gnyen po yod mod/

ci'i phyir spang bya yin zhe na/ nyon mongs ni sdug bsngal bskyed pas dgra bzhin du ltas nas spang bar bya dgos te/ 'dod chags ni 'dod pa'i yul dang*/ ma phrad pa'i tshor ba las sdug bsngal 'byung la/ khro ba ni dgra stobs ldan gzhom pa'i dpung med pa'i tshor ba las sdug bsngal 'byung zhing*/ gti mug ni don zhib mdo yongs su mi shes pa'i sems kyis sdug bsngal bskyed pa'i phyir ro/ /gal te don la sdug bsngal du gnas mod/ re zhig gnod par mi gnon pas spang bar bya ba ma yin no zhe na/ nyon mongs pas gnod par mi shes pa'i gang zag ni shin tu sdug bsngal ba can yin te/ nyon mongs pa de dag de dag gis zil gyis mnan pa na/ sdug bsngal de dag yod kyang mi rtogs pa ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'ba' zhig la gnas pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du/ rang nyid bskal ba bral phyir 'dir/ / skyes gang 'dod don mi thob pa/ /de la de las gzhan pa yi/ /sdug bsngal ches dka' ci zhig 'grub/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gti mug chags sdang （21na）gnyis ka dang lhan cig bzhin du+u chags sdang gnyis kyang lhan cig yod dam zhe na/ ji ltar bad kan chu las gyur pa dang*/ mkhris pa me las gyur pa gnyis mi mthun pas lhan cig phrad pa med par mthong ba de bzhin du/ khro ba la yang 'dod chags dang yul gcig la lhan cig phrad pa med par mthong ste/ 'dun pa dang rgyab kyis phyogs pas phan tshun rnam pa 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du/ 'gal phyir mes gyur mkhris pa la/ /chu las gyur pa'i bad kan dang*/ /ji ltar lhan cig phrad med ltar| |'dod chags zhe sdang dag de bzhin/ /zhes so/ /de ltar 'dod chags dang zhe sdang gnyis kyi mtshan nyid dang*/ byed las shes par byas nas slob ma'i blo 'chos par byed do/ /de yang slob ma 'dod chags can ni bran bzhin du las la bkol bar bya ste rgyu mtshan gang gi phyir na/ mi phongs shing sri ba med pa ni 'dod chags de'i sman yin pa'i phyir ro/

khong khro ba can la ni rje bo bzhin du/ blta bar bya ste/ phangs shing rim gro byas pa la zhe sdang mi skye bas/ khong khro de'i sman gnyen po ni phangs pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du/ bla ma gang zhig bsam shes nas/ /slob ma rjes su 'chos nus pa/ /de yis slob ma gzung bya ste/ /blun pos bcos par 'os ma yin/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ nyon mongs skye ba'i dus kyang nges par byas nas/ dus dang 'tsham par gnyen po bsten par bya ste/ mtshan mo gnyid dang rmugs pa 'phel zhing*| |bad kan shas che bas snga dro dang por gti mug yang dag par 'byung la/ bar du bkres skom gyis gdung ba sel ba'i ched du 'tshol khro'i sdug bsngal dang*/ mkhris pa shas che bas khro ba 'byung bar 'gyur zhing*/ phyis nyi ma nub nas ni ngal dub dang bkres skom gyi sdug bsngal dang bral nas 'dod chags 'byung ba ste nyon mongs rnams nyin ma gcig la rim pa bzhin du 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du/ gang zhig nyon mongs rim shes nas/ /de gzhom la tshul sgom byed pa/ /de yis de dag sel byed de/ /sman pa'i rgyal pos nad rnams bzhin/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa la gnyis/ dug gsum spaung tshul spy-ir bstan/ khong khro spang tshul bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ dngos kyi don/ nyon mongs spyod pa'i gang gi rang bzhin bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'dod chags ni mdza' shes kyi tshul gyis 'jig rten bslu bar byed pas/ bsgrims te spang bar bya dgos so/ / de yang zhe sdang ni gnod pa ltar snang bas bsrung bar sla ste/ tshor ba yid mi bde ba dang mtshungs par ldan pas/ dgra bo'i tshul du skye ba'i phyir/ gti mug ni dgra gnyen bar ltar snang bas/ yid mi brten cing bsrung bar sla ste/ tshor ba btang snyoms dang mtshungs par ldan pas/ phan gnod gang yang mi byed pa'i tshul du skye ba'i phyir ro/ /'dod chags de la khyod mi 'jigs te 'jigs par rigs te/

'dod （21ba）ni sdug bsngal bskyed pas mdza' bo ma yin kyang mdza' bshes dang 'dra bar bcos nas dge ba'i nor 'phrog par byed pa des na ste de'i phyir ro| |des na 'dod chags la skabs mi sbyin par nam skyes pa na bzlog par bya ste| mi phan zhing gnod pa byed pa'i mdza' bo'i tshul du 'chos pa ni/ khyad par du skyes bu dam pas spang bar bya ba ma yin nam ste spang bya yin pa'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du/ ji ltar mi phan bzhin zhim zas/ /gang de las bdag sgrim srung ba/ / de bzhin mdza' gdong 'dod chags la/ /'bad pas bdag nyid bsrung bar bya// zhes so/ /'o na 'dod chags las tshul ji ltar bsrung zhe na/ rtag tu yid mi gtad cing nyon mongs bsten pa'i sgo nas 'dod chags skye ba'i skabs mi 'byed pa'o| |de yang 'dod chags ni gnyis su nges te/ 'dod chag kha cig ni sngaun rigs mthun gyi rgyu las skye ba 'gyur zhing*/ kha cig ni phral gyi rkyen las kyang ni skye ba ste rgyu rkyen gyi stobs kyis 'dod chags gnyis su nges pa'i phyir ro/ /'dod chags rkyen la skye ba gang yin pa de ni/ gnyen po sgrub sla ste/ rkyen spangs pas mi skye ba'i phyir ro/ /cig shos rgyu las skyes pa ni spangs sla ba ma yin te/ goms pa'i stobs las skye bas gnyen po chen pos spangs dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du| nyon mongs can gang phrad pa las/ /yin te 'bad pas rnam par 'byung*/ / rang bzhin nyid kyi nyon mongs can/ /gang de tshegs kyis 'byung bar 'gyur/ / zhes so/ khong khro ni nyes pa shin tu che bas bsgrims te spang bar bya ste/ khro ba ni 'khon 'dzin brtan zhing dam du 'dzin pa dang*/ nges par mtha' gcig tu mi dge zhing*| |rang gzhan gyi rgyud sreg la dge rtsa 'joms pa dang*/ mtshams med sogs nyes pa chen po byed pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar nyon mongs pa'i gnyen po bsten nas spaung bar rigs te/ rnam pa kun tu nyon mongs rnams kyi dbye ba

dang*| |rang bzhin dang*/ nyes dmigs dang*/ spong ba'i thabs shes par byas nas nyon mongs pa rnams rtsa ba bcad pa'i sgo nas mthar byed par 'gyur ba'i phyir| |ji skad du/ nyon mongs rnams dbye shes byas nas/ /gang zhig mi mthun phyogs bsten des/ /myur du zhi ba thob te dper/ /sman 'phrod bsten pa'i nad pa bzhin/ /zhes so/ /'o na gti mug gis ni spang ba'i tshul ji lta bu zhe na/ gti mug ni nyes pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba byed cing*/ phyin ci log tu sgro 'dogs pas na rten 'brel gyi rang bzhin rtogs pa'i sgo nas spang bar bya dgos te/ rten 'brel gyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i sgo nas/ gti mug bcom pas nyon mongs pa thams cad kyang bcom par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /rtags grub ste/ dper na lus la lus dbang ji bzhin du gti mug ni nyon mongs kun la khyab cing gnas par 'gyur ba de'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du/ ji ltar mgo bo bcad pa na/ /srog ni rab tu mi 'jug pa/ /de bzhin gti mug （22na）bcad pa yis/ /nyon mongs 'khor lo 'jug mi 'a gyur/ /zhes so/ /nyes pa kun gyi rtsa ba gti mug 'di spong ba'i thabs ci ltar shes par bya zhe na/ 'bad pa kun gyis bstan bcos 'dir rten 'byung rang bzhin med pa'i gtam de kho na bsnyad par bya ma yin te/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba rang bzhin gyis med pa ni mthong zhing goms pa na/ gti mug 'byung bar mi 'gyur zhing*/ gti mug spangs pas nyon mongs thams cad spong bar 'gyur ba de'i phyir ro/

/ji skad du/ gti mug rkyen nyid 'di ba yi/ /nyi ma'i 'od zer 'bar rnams dang*/ /lhan cig gnas pa ma yin te/ / nyi ma'i zer dang mun pa bzhin/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis/ nyon mongs can gyi gang zag gi mtshan nyid/ de nyid 'dul ba'i thabs bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni nyon mongs la spyod pa'i gang zag rnams kyi khyad par ji ltar shes par bya zhe na/ nyon mongs pa can gyi gang zag ni lus ngag gi tha snyad kyi sgo nas shes par bya ste/ dus rtag tu sa 'dzin/ gar dang bzhad gad sogs la dga' la gzhan la gtong ba po dang rang nyid za ba po dang*/ gtsang sbra che zhing 'gyur ba mi brtan pa de 'dra ba la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid rnams 'dod chags can gyi mi la snang zhing*/ de las ldog pa ni zhe sdang can dang*/ 'dres par gcod pa ni gti mug can la snang ba'i phyir ro/ /ji skad du/ 'dod chags kyis gzhan chags byed cing*/ rang chags bya la cher dgar 'gyur/ /sdang bas 'di dag las bzlog cing*/ /gti mug gis de rmongs par byed/ /zhes so// gnyis pa ni/ 'o na gang zag nyon mongs can 'dul ba'i thabs gang yin zhe na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi chags can rnams la zas dang*/ chos gos dang gtsug lag khang la sogs pa dge legs sam bzang po spangs pa thams cad dag bsten pa dang*/ rtag tu bla ma'i thad steng drung du gnas par gsungs te/ zas gos sogs la zhen pa'i gnyen po sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ rtag tu bla ma bsten pas bcas pa'i mtshams las 'da' bar mi 'gyur zhing*/ mya ngan kho na la gzhol bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /zhe sdang la spyod pa ni de las ldog pa'i gtsug lag khang la sogs pa gya nom pa dang*/ gnas dben pa rnams bsten dgos te/ de la brten nas zhe sdang srab par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gti mug la spyod pa la ni de dag 'dres ma ci rigs pa bsten nas gti mug dgag par bya ste/ de la brten nas blang dor shes par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/
